summary: A Sydney commercial and property law firm with over 30 years of experience is a strength, but mismatched links and no contact form appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to have no contact form, only an email address, a phone number and office hours.
findings.cost: A business owner with an urgent matter has to switch to email or phone instead of sending a quick message.
findings.fix: A short confidential enquiry form that sends straight to your team.

findings.problem: Menu labels appear not to match their pages: 'legal services for business' appears to link to /portfolio/private-services/ and 'succession planning' to /portfolio/one-more/.
findings.cost: Clients land on the wrong page and a placeholder slug looks unfinished.
findings.fix: Labels and pages that match, with clean addresses.

findings.problem: Leftover interface text appears on the page ('Loading', 'Carousel controls Previous Next') and news dates appear as 'October 30, 2026by' with no space.
findings.cost: Visible leftovers and typos make a professional firm look careless.

findings.problem: The claim 'australia's no.1 development' appears with no source, and no testimonials, named lawyers or certifications appear.
findings.cost: Unsupported claims and missing proof give a developer little reason to trust you.
findings.fix: Named partners, testimonials and sourced credentials.

redesign: Named partners, testimonials and sourced credentials.
